senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; מָהַר)exchange, esp. the price paid for the wife; (in later practice) the wife’s settlement, widowhood (כתובה). Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 17 (ref. to Ex. XXII, 15) מלמד שהוא עוֹשָׂהּ עליו מ׳ this indicates that he (the father) imposes it upon him (the seducer) as a mohar; ואין מ׳ אלא כתובה וכ׳ and mohar means k’thubah, as we read (Gen. XXXIV, 12) &c.; Y. Keth. III, 27ᵈ top (read אותה for אותן). Bab.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 10a:4">Keth. 10ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:16">Ex. XXII, 16</cite>) <he>שיהא זה כמ׳ הבתולות וכ׳</he> that this (fine) be equal to the indemnity for outraged virginity (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:29">Deut. XXII, 29</cite>), and the settlement of virgins be like this (indemnity, i.e. fifty Shekel silver); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M00433"><he>מוֹהֲרִין</he></cite>, constr. <he>מוֹהֲרֵי</he>. Y. ib. III, beg. 27ᵃ [read:] <he>אילו היה כתיב כמוֹהֲרֵי בתולות יאות</he> if it read, like the indemnities for virgins, it might be right (as you say).
